title: China Youth Corps' designation as KMT-affiliated organization upheld
summary: Taipei, Oct. 9 (CNA) A 2018 ruling by the Ill-gotten Party Assets Settlement Committee (CIPAS) designating the China Youth Corps (CYC) as an "affiliated organization" of the Kuomintang (KMT) was upheld by the Supreme Administrative Court on Thursday.

228 foreign guests to attend 2026 ROC National Day celebrations: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Oct. 8 (CNA) A total of 228 foreign guests will take part in 2026 Republic of China (Taiwan) National Day celebrations, including King Mswati III of Taiwan's sole African ally Eswatini and Indiana Lieutenant Governor Micah Beckwith, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) on Thursday.

title: MAC slams Beijing over threats tied to Kevin Tsai's campaign appearance
summary: Taipei, Oct. 8 (CNA) Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) on Thursday criticized Beijing after a Chinese military-linked social media account appeared to threaten television host Kevin Tsai (蔡康永) for attending a campaign event for Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋).

title: Premier looks to issue NT$10,000 cash handout by Lunar New Year
summary: Taipei, Oct. 8 (CNA) The government plans to start issuing a proposed NT$10,000 (US$313) cash handout in January, before the Lunar New Year holiday, if the 2027 general budget clears legislative review by Jan. 5, Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) said Thursday.

title: Taiwan cooperation key to Indo-Pacific stability: Ex-President Tsai
summary: San Francisco, Oct. 7 (CNA) Former Taiwan President Tsai Ing-wen (蔡英文) said Wednesday that deeper international cooperation with Taiwan will not only strengthen its security, but also boost stability in the Indo-Pacific and the resilience of other democracies.
